summary: The FCC comments argue against proposed rule changes to E-Rate, stating that they would negatively impact the public good and reduce parental rights. The comments emphasize the importance of continuing to provide E-Rate support at a minimum level.

claims.argument: Proposed rule changes would negatively impact the public good and reduce parental rights
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate is serving its intended purpose and must continue to do so at a minimum of the support it is currently providing. These proposed rule changes would have a negative impact on the public good and would take away parental rights beyond the duty of the FCC.
